data.outcome_summary: TALIS Starting Strong 2024 is an OECD large-scale survey of early childhood education and care (ECEC) staff and setting leaders, using self-reported questionnaires about background, training, daily work, practices with children and families, and well-being and career intentions. In Sweden, the participant note reports indicators for pre-primary settings (ISCED 02), covering preschool (0–5) and preschool classes (age 6), and compares Sweden with other participating countries and subnational entities. The results are presented as descriptive percentages and differences (e.g., staff time in direct contact with children, professional development needs by diversity dimension, leader-reported staffing constraints, and stress sources). The note also flags that some estimates should be interpreted with caution due to higher risk of non-response bias.
